notes: Shipped ZoMBI-Hop configuration: the value of every TUNED hyperparameter (src/hparams.py loads it as DEFAULT_HPARAMS, used by the GUI, the hardware runner and as ZoMBIHop's constructor defaults). It must list exactly the tuned knobs.
Origin: the 6D MOBO ensemble winner, with n_consecutive_converged 5->2 (2026-08-19) and max_iterations 2->3 (2026-08-27).

2026-10-12: needle_shrink_factor 0.99->0.8 and needle_stop_noise_multiplier 1.0->2.0 — the code used bounds_shrink_factor=0.8 / min_axis_noise_mult=2.0 instead, so these are the values every run actually had. The needle gates, Jaccard knobs, ellipsoid_drop_fraction and input_noise_threshold_mult were hidden constructor defaults and are listed at those defaults.
